methods.label: Expand and compare the expressions
methods.explanation:
Expanding the product reveals which terms must match:
\[
\begin{aligned}
(10a+b)(10a+c)
&=100a^2+10ab+10ac+bc\\
&=100a^2+10a(b+c)+bc.
\end{aligned}
\]
The proposed expression is
\[
100a(a+1)+bc=100a^2+100a+bc.
\]
Canceling the matching terms shows that equality holds exactly when
\[
10a(b+c)=100a.
\]
Because \(a\) is positive, \(10a\ne0\), so division gives \(b+c=10\). Conversely, this condition makes the expanded expressions equal. The answer is \(\boxed{b+c=10}\), choice A.
